h: Actress Linda Osifo gets engaged, shares proposal video
p: Nollywood actress Linda Osifo has announced her engagement to her partner, Ose, sharing a video of the proposal. She thanked God for answering a private prayer.
body: Nollywood actress Linda Osifo has announced that she is engaged to her partner, identified as Mr Ose.
The actress shared a romantic video of the proposal on her social media page on Monday, 16 November 2026, and wrote an emotional message alongside it.

Osifo said God had answered a prayer she once made quietly, adding that it came in his own time and not the way she had imagined. She described the love story as worth every season of waiting and told her fiancé she would choose him in every lifetime, ending with an excited declaration that she had said yes.
more: She shared a video of the proposal.
She called him the man she would choose in every lifetime.
